lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: The Depot. Nightshift headquarters. You clock in, you clock out, the Foreman counts the rest.
A punch clock. You slide your hand into the slot where a card should go.
NO CARD.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Shh! Shh shh shh. It's very loud. It's built to be loud.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Side door. Come on. I've got this.
A huge rolling door. Locked from the inside. You would need about forty of you.
A crate stamped FRAGILE: MORNINGS. It is very light.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Hold on.
Wick hooks the latch with the tip of his pole and lifts.
Click.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Apprentice trick. Don't tell the Foreman. Don't tell anyone. Don't tell me.
Inside, everything has a label. Even the labels have labels.

lines.speaker: foreman
lines.text: Wick. You are seven lamps behind.

lines.speaker: foreman
lines.text: And who is this?

lines.speaker: foreman
lines.text: Not on the schedule.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: He's okay! He held the light on Maple! He's a natural! Kind of!

lines.speaker: foreman
lines.text: The Un-Baker says he's owed a loaf. By a kid. In pajamas.

lines.speaker: foreman
lines.text: Hm.

lines.speaker: foreman
lines.text: Fine. Curfew's on the square. Curfew will sort it out.

lines.speaker: foreman
lines.text: But nobody walks through my depot without paperwork.
He slides a form across the desk. It is four pages long.
You fill it out. It takes a while.
The last box says BEDTIME. You write 8:30.

lines.speaker: foreman
lines.text: Eight-thirty. Huh. That explains a lot.

lines.speaker: foreman
lines.text: Square's through the big door on the right. Lost-and-found's by the side door. Kids lose things.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Thank you, sir. Sorry, sir. Seven lamps, sir.

lines.speaker: foreman
lines.text: Paperwork first.

lines.speaker: foreman
lines.text: Curfew. The square. Through the big door. Go.

lines.speaker: foreman
lines.text: Help Wanted board is on the wall. We are always hiring. We are never hiring kids.

lines.speaker: foreman
lines.text: And I still want my loaf.

lines.speaker: foreman
lines.text: Hey. Paperwork first.
The Help Wanted board. Cards pinned in neat rows.
Time cards. One slot for every worker. WICK. UN-BAKER. POSTMAN. CURFEW. A lot of names you don't know yet.
One slot at the end has no name on it.
Lockers. One is labeled SPARE PENCILS. It is completely full.
Through the window: the square, and the clock tower above it.
Boxes of lightbulbs, sorted by how sleepy they look.
LOST & FOUND. A mitten. A key. A yo-yo with no string.
And a pocket watch. Its hands are stopped at 2:00.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Don't wind it. Seriously. You don't wind things you find at the Depot.

lines.speaker: foreman
lines.text: That's Lost-and-Found property. And you owe the Un-Baker a loaf. One more form.
You fill out one more form. It asks for your bedtime again.
You wind it. Click. Click. Click.
The second hand jumps forward... then runs backward for a moment, and stops.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: ...I said don't wind it.

lines.speaker: wick
lines.text: Okay. Okay. If it does anything weird, that's on the watch. Not on me.
You got the pocket watch. In a fight, press {rewind} to wind the last two seconds back. Three times a fight.
The mitten, the key, the yo-yo. In your pocket, the watch ticks. Sometimes backward.
